items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One time I was invited up to someone’s apartment with Chick, Dave Holland, Barry Altschul, and Anthony Braxton. I think Anthony and I were auditioning to play with the group called “Circle”

ctx.x: “Duende” yeah. One time I was invited up to someone’s apartment with Chick, Dave Holland, Barry Altschul, and Anthony Braxton. I think Anthony and I were auditioning to play with the group called “Circle” and Anthony won out.
